title: Open Logix remote config
description: What one Open Logix component's releases on a channel use: its direct dependencies, each naming a GitHub release and its file, and the component's own newest release on the channel. A component reads remote-config/<product>/<NNN>/<channel>-channel.jsonc from its own repo, by the config version it hard-codes and its channel (Remote updates, in the website repo's CLAUDE.md). The dependencies serve every release on the channel, not only latest. The file is JSONC: comments say why each entry changed.

dependencies.description: The direct dependencies, by package name.

dependency.description: A dependency, keyed by its package name, such as logix-catalog.

repo.description: The GitHub repo of its releases, owner/name, such as openlogix/logix-catalog.

release.description: The release tag, yyyy-mm-dd. A prod config (prod-channel.jsonc) names only stable releases; other channels may name pre-releases.

file.description: The release file's name, a template: ${PLATFORM} is the platform, such as darwin-arm64, and ${YYYYMMDD} the release tag without dashes. Such as logix-core-${PLATFORM}-${YYYYMMDD}.tgz.

latest.description: The component's own newest release on this channel, the one its users should have; a release on the channel's list in assign.jsonc, the newest one. The component tells its users when it's newer than itself (Check for Updates); nothing downloads it, so file is optional (a component with one file per platform names it; Logix IDE's installers differ by platform, so it has none).
